jei.simpleores.info.sage_ore: Generates in the Overworld as rarely as diamond ore; needs an iron pickaxe. Drops 3 to 7 experience and rarely a Sage Orb (Silk Touch: the ore itself).
jei.simpleores.info.sage_orb: Rare drop of Sage Ore (2 %, up to 5 % with Fortune). Right-click to charge it for 0.3 seconds; it gives 50 to 100 experience.
jei.simpleores.info.dimensional_scrap: Found in every dimension, rarer than ancient debris. Only an Enderite Pickaxe or Sledgehammer can mine it. No use yet.
jei.simpleores.info.lead_ore: Overworld: only in stone (not deepslate), 6 veins of 9 per chunk between Y 0 and 72, never touching air. End: End Lead Ore in the End stone of the outer islands, 6 veins of 7, Y 20 to 80, never at air. Stone pickaxe; drops 1 to 2 raw lead. Deepslate Lead Ore no longer generates.
jei.simpleores.info.zinc_ore: Zinc forms no free veins: only closed mini geodes (5 x 5 x 5, crust of Geode Crust, calcite lining) hold 1 to 8 zinc ores, always fully enclosed in stone (Y -56 to 40, 2 tries per chunk). End: geodes in the End stone of the outer islands, End stone shell, Geode Crust lining, 1 to 8 End Zinc Ores (Y 20 to 80). Stone pickaxe; drops raw zinc.
jei.simpleores.info.geode_crust: The shell of the zinc mini geodes in the Overworld and their lining in the End. Find this crust while mining and the zinc ores are right behind it. Pickaxe.
jei.simpleores.info.nickel_ore: Only in deepslate, like diamond ore: 10 veins of 6 per chunk, most at the bottom of the world (Y -64), up to Y 16; half of the blocks touching air are discarded. A little more common than diamond. Iron pickaxe; drops raw nickel. Stone nickel ore no longer generates.
jei.simpleores.info.tin_ore: Mountain tin: veins in stone and granite between Y 20 and 80, dense nests inside granite blobs, and extra veins up to Y 180 in the mountains (stony, jagged and frozen peaks, snowy slopes, windswept hills). Stone pickaxe; drops raw tin. Rarely also tin-bearing gravel and sand in river and beach beds.
jei.simpleores.info.tin_bearing_gravel: Rare small patches under water in river and beach beds (one in every 3rd chunk of those biomes): sand turns into tin-bearing sand, gravel, dirt and clay into tin-bearing gravel. Dig it with a shovel: 2 to 5 tin nuggets (Fortune helps, Silk Touch keeps the block).
text.autoconfig.simpleores.title: Simple Ores
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.enable:
Off stops new silver, lead, zinc, nickel and tin veins and hides the creative entries; existing blocks and items keep working.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.soundp:
Lead blocks on the way between a sound and the player make it quieter (world sounds only, from volume 0.3).
Default: true.

Each lead block on the way multiplies the volume by this factor. Range 0.2 to 0.9.
Default: 0.5.

A muffled sound quieter than this is not sent to the player at all. Range 0.01 to 0.3.
Default: 0.05.

Records and music devices are muffled by lead walls as well.
Default: false.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.sageOr:
Off: no new Sage Ore in the Overworld. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks.
Default: true.
Sage Ore in the Nether and the End

Off: no new Nether Sage Ore and End Sage Ore (they drop sage crystal shards). Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.roseGo:
Chance in percent for each Nether gold ore block of a vein below Y 31 (the lava ocean) to be Nether Rose Gold Ore instead; a vein holds at most one. 0 = none. Range 0 to 10. Takes effect in newly generated chunks.
Default: 2.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.dimens:
Off: no new Dimensional Scrap in any dimension. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.leadOr:
Off: no new lead veins (stone only, Y 0 to 72, never touching air). Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.endLea:
Off: no new End lead veins in the End stone of the outer islands. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.zincGe:
Off: no new closed mini geodes with 1 to 8 zinc ores in the Overworld (zinc forms no free veins). Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.endZin:
Off: no new mini geodes with 1 to 8 End zinc ores in the End stone of the outer islands. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.nickel:
Off: no new nickel veins (deepslate, like diamond ore). Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.tinOre:
Off: no new tin veins in stone and granite (Y 20 to 80) and no extra veins of the mountain biomes. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
text.autoconfig.simpleores.option.tinPla:
Off: no new tin-bearing gravel and sand in river and beach beds. Takes effect at the next world start in newly generated chunks; existing ores stay.
Default: true.
simpleores.guide.page.1.title: Simple Ores
simpleores.guide.page.1: Silver ore in the Overworld and the End with the silver arrow against the undead and the silver mirror, lead whose blocks muffle sound and stop the Sculk, and rose gold:
simpleores.guide.page.2.title: Simple Ores
simpleores.guide.page.2: two alloys of gold, copper and silver, pressed into bundles, smelted in the blast furnace only, with tools and armor of their own.
simpleores.guide.page.3.title: Silver
simpleores.guide.page.3: A pale metal found in the Overworld and the End. It is rarer than gold and not a tool material: it is an ingredient (rose gold) and a building metal.
simpleores.guide.page.4.title: Rose gold
simpleores.guide.page.4: Two alloys of gold, copper and silver: Rose Gold and the stronger-gold Rose Copper, which is made from Rose Gold. Made in two steps: press ingots into pressings, melt them in a blast furnace.
simpleores.guide.page.5.title: Rose gold tools and armor
simpleores.guide.page.5: Sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe and a full armor set of each alloy. Both mine like iron; neither beats diamond.
simpleores.guide.page.6.title: Rose gold apples
simpleores.guide.page.6: A plain and an enchanted apple of each alloy, between the golden apple and the Netherite apple. Always edible, no cooldown.
simpleores.guide.page.7.title: Lead
simpleores.guide.page.7: A dull, heavy metal of the stone layer and the End. Lead blocks stop the Sculk from hearing, withstand explosions and muffle sound - but are loud themselves.
simpleores.guide.page.8.title: Zinc, nickel, tin and their alloys
simpleores.guide.page.8: Three more metals of the Overworld and their plain alloys brass, stainless steel and bronze. Building and decoration metals: no tools, no armor, no change to Vanilla (RG30-2).
simpleores.guide.page.9.title: Soundproofing
simpleores.guide.page.9: Lead walls make the world quieter on the other side: a TNT blast behind a few lead blocks is only a dull thud, or not heard at all.
simpleores.guide.page.10.title: Silver mirror
simpleores.guide.page.10: A wall decoration of silver and glass.
simpleores.guide.page.11.title: Enderite
simpleores.guide.page.11: The tier above netherite (moved here from SimpleLib, IG31-13). The Enderite variants of the other Simple mods - chests, furnaces, crucibles, hammers, backpacks - appear only while Simple Ores is installed.
simpleores.guide.page.12.title: Nether Rose Gold Ore
simpleores.guide.page.12: A rare rose gold find hidden in the Nether gold veins, deep down in the heat.
simpleores.guide.page.13.title: Sage Crystal
simpleores.guide.page.13: The ingot-sized material of the sage family, found as shards in the Nether and the End.
simpleores.guide.page.14.title: Sage Ore and Dimensional Scrap
simpleores.guide.page.14: Two rare finds that moved here from SimpleBuilding (IG31-13): the sage ore with its experience orb, and the scrap of the three dimensions.
simpleores.guide.page.15.title: Rift alloys
simpleores.guide.page.15: The Dimensional Scrap of each dimension melts into rift shards; with a partner ingot they make Terranite, Infernite and Zenithite, a chain through all three dimensions that starts at Enderite (IG31-58).
simpleores.guide.page.16.title: Settings
simpleores.guide.page.16: More settings are in the mod's config screen.
